input.quote: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT, TRUELINK DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL EXPENSES WARRANTIES, WARRANTIES OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FOR ANY MATTER RELATING TO THE ACCURACY OR COMPLETENESS, OR TIMING OF TRANSMISSION OF ANY DATA SUBMITTED THROUGH THE INTERFACE OR TO OR FROM THE WEB SITE.
input.rationale: TrueLink's only express warranties are Y2K-readiness (Section 9); there is no conformance-to-documentation warranty and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy, and everything else is disclaimed in Section 12, with Section 11 offering only a self-referential standard of care. That fails the fallback, so we inserted the standard workmanlike and 90-day conformance warranty with remedies, expressly carved out of the disclaimer.

input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant at all, yet TrueLink hosts our Web Site and processes borrower credit data — walk-away territory under this rule. We inserted a short insurance section (CGL, E&O and cyber, certificates on request) in the general provisions; E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is our fallback.

input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5 imposes a monthly fee floor rather than a multi-year take-or-pay, and Client can exit that exposure at any time under Section 14 (effective the end of the following month) with no penalty, which sits within the fallback. We note for the commercial team that the minimum amounts are still blank and that Section 6 excludes those minimums from our documentation and dispute rights — points to settle before signature rather than a playbook deviation.

input.quote: If Client decides to discontinue its Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days. In case of discontinued Service, Client shall retain full ownership of all domains associated with Client and Client Content. If Client decides to discontinue Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new hosting environment within 60 days.
input.rationale: Exit obligations run only against Client (arranging a new name server and hosting environment); TrueLink owes no transition assistance, no return or export of Client Content, Credit Data or backups, and no deletion certification, which is a deviation for a hosting vendor. We inserted our standard six-month transition assistance, 30-day data return and certified deletion language into the termination provisions; 90 days of assistance is our fallback.
